findings.title: Lost subagent-duration INSERT regression check
findings.problem: Commit ebe08c47f on this branch misplaced the trailing assertion of test_a_computed_subagent_duration_is_never_negative (`assert duration in rollups._SUBAGENT_INVOCATIONS`) onto the end of the newly-added test_kind_4_rollup_excludes_builtin_commands, where `duration` is undefined (NameError). This diff removes that orphaned line to fix the NameError but never restores the assertion to its rightful test, so the check is now gone entirely.
findings.impact: No test in test_rollups.py verifies that the computed subagent duration expression (rollups._ms_between(...)) is actually wired into the _SUBAGENT_INVOCATIONS INSERT statement; a future refactor could silently drop that column binding with nothing failing.
findings.recommendation: Append `assert duration in rollups._SUBAGENT_INVOCATIONS` back onto test_a_computed_subagent_duration_is_never_negative, after its current last line.

finding_status.notes: Line 1037 of test_rollups.py now reads `assert duration in rollups._SUBAGENT_INVOCATIONS` inside test_a_computed_subagent_duration_is_never_negative, where `duration` is defined; the orphaned copy in test_kind_4_rollup_excludes_builtin_commands is removed. Verified against current source at reviewed_head's successor.
